description: Synthetic patient-portal history for one patient (Rosa Delgado) from January 2025 to November 2026: eight message threads, twenty-three claims with cent-exact insurance arithmetic including two denials later reprocessed, two payments, three statements, thirteen appointments and a four-week slot calendar. Generated by scripts/generate-fixture.cjs from authored narrative; no real patient data and no crawling.

sources.description: Authored narrative plus computed schedules and ledger arithmetic; scripts/generate-fixture.cjs is the sole source. Public patient-portal help pages were read only to mirror interaction patterns; no content was copied.

transformations: Slot calendars and ledger arithmetic computed; IDs, dates and references checked by validateSeed; amounts stored as integer cents.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace a human read-through of realism and variation; recorded here before submission.
